name: kit
description: A Claude Code kit that trains the person asking. The MENTOR coaches how each request was framed before the work runs, then grades the ask out of 100 — framing, leverage, and learnings applied — into an append-only ledger per repo. The CRITIC judges the work in fresh context and its own words: did the thing you ASKED for actually happen, was each claim backed by a check that could have failed, did it stay in scope. It records a VERDICT rather than a score, and every future critic is handed the last one so a recurring fault gets named. The SCORECARD renders the ledger as a published board with XP, levels, streaks and badges.
